root_idea.summary: The root centers on the appearance or surface of a thing, especially the visible human exterior, with an associated sense of beauty or pleasant change.
root_idea.development: From the visible skin and surface, the root develops meanings of human beings, intimate skin-to-skin contact, the brightening of the face, glad tidings that visibly affect the recipient, and signs or beginnings appearing on a surface.

qac_form_accounting.reason: بُشْر is a synonymous variant of بُشْرَىٰ meaning glad tidings and is best presented with that public lexical form.
This is the feminine plural active participle of مُبَشِّر and expresses the same bearer-or-herald function.

senses.definition: To announce good news or glad tidings to someone.
senses.usage_conditions: Commonly construed with بِـ for the event announced and with a person as recipient; the recipient may be given news of forgiveness, reward, birth, victory, or another favorable event.

senses.definition: To announce a distressing event, especially as a denunciation or bitter irony.
senses.usage_conditions: The same announcing construction can be used for punishment or other bad news; the positive sense is the ordinary unmarked usage, while the negative sense is clear from the announced event or an accompanying restriction.

senses.definition: To come into intimate skin-to-skin contact; to approach sexually or have sexual intercourse.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic construction refers to intimate contact with a spouse and can encompass intercourse as well as direct bodily contact; the wording does not itself impose a narrower object-class restriction.

senses.definition: To receive or find glad tidings; to be assured by good news.
senses.usage_conditions: In the supplied Quran occurrence it is an imperative addressed to a group, with the good outcome understood from context.

senses.definition: To make the face beautiful and bright.
senses.usage_conditions: This sense is preserved from a reported Quran reading in which the result of divine favor is expressed as the beautifying and brightening of the servants' faces; it is not represented by a separate supplied QAC occurrence.

senses.definition: To rejoice or become glad in response to good news or a favorable prospect.
senses.usage_conditions: The form presents the subject as experiencing or entering into gladness, whether on receiving news, learning of a favor, or anticipating a good outcome.

senses.definition: A human being, considered in bodily or visible human form.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran uses the word for human beings in general, including singular, dual, and plural reference, especially where their corporeal or outward human condition is in view.

senses.definition: A bearer or announcer of glad tidings; one who brings good news.
senses.usage_conditions: The word may function as a substantive or adjective and can describe a person who announces favorable news.

senses.definition: Glad tidings; a joyful announcement or good news.
senses.usage_conditions: When used absolutely, the word denotes favorable news; a negative result is expressed only where the context or an accompanying phrase explicitly reverses the normal positive implication.

senses.definition: One who brings or announces glad tidings; a bearer or herald of good news.
senses.usage_conditions: The participle can describe human messengers and, by extension, things such as winds that herald rain or another favorable event.

senses.definition: Rejoicing or showing gladness in response to good news.
senses.usage_conditions: This active participle describes the state resulting from the Form X experience of gladness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pare or strip the outer skin or surface from a hide.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The action concerns removing or exposing the hide's outer layer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make oneself light of flesh or reduce one's bodily bulk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This rare, figurative usage occurs in an admonitory saying about preparing oneself for reciting the Quran.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For locusts to strip the ground by consuming what lies on its surface.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meaning is extended from removing a surface layer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To clip the moustache closely enough for the skin beneath to appear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a conventional grooming usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To meet someone with a cheerful or pleasant countenance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb describes the visible expression shown in meeting another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rejoice at or become glad because of an event or its announcement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the Form I intransitive emotional usage, distinct in headword and morphology from Form X اِسْتَبْشَرَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a she-camel to make known that she has begun to conceive or become pregnant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The pregnancy is treated as an announced favorable event.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For enjoyment or comfort to attend someone closely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a tropical extension of intimate contact, as though enjoyment adhered to the skin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To experience the joy or happiness arising from certainty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used metaphorically of feeling certainty as an immediate, intimate presence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To manage, conduct, or personally attend to an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction emphasizes direct personal involvement, literally conducting something with one's own person or hand.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a she-camel to conceive or become pregnant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meaning is explained as an event that brings glad news to its owner.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the earth to put forth herbage visible upon its surface.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage describes vegetation emerging into view.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For people to announce a joyful event to one another and rejoice one another with it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a reciprocal Form VI construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To demand a reward from someone for announcing joyful tidings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This transitive construction differs from the Quranic intransitive sense of rejoicing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Cheerfulness, openness, and pleasantness of countenance; happiness or gladness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes the visible expression or the accompanying emotional state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The external skin, cuticle, or epidermis.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may refer to the outer skin of a human being and, according to some authorities, of other creatures.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Complexion or hue; fineness or delicacy of appearance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized nominal extension from the visible outer skin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Herbage or leguminous growth appearing on the surface of the earth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression may refer to the earth's visible vegetation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man's hand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a rare assumed-tropical usage derived from direct bodily contact or action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Human; belonging or relating to mankind or a human being.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Adjectival usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The refuse or lowest, basest, or meanest portion of mankind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative collective designation for people of the lowest rank.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Goodly, beautiful, or elegant in form or features.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person, face, woman, or she-camel; the she-camel usage can include a specified condition of bodily fatness or breed, but those details are not general to the adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Goodliness, beauty, or elegance of form or features.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Nominal usage concerning visible appearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Material pared from the face of a hide.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The material removed from the back of the hide has a different conventional designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A gift or reward given to the person who announces a joyful event.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word can denote the announcer's remuneration, distinct from the news itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More goodly, beautiful, elegant, or well-fleshed than another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Comparative usage applied to bodily appearance or features.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular bird, the ṣufāriyya.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical animal name, not a productive verbal Form V meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Beginnings, first signs, or early manifestations of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the first blossoms, the first light or signs of dawn, the beginning of rain, and the first visible colors or early fruiting of palm trees.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Streaks or marks appearing upon a surface.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Examples include streaks of dawn light, marks made by wind on the ground, and marks of galls on an animal's side.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A complete or well-balanced person combining softness or gentleness with strength and practical knowledge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The idiom evokes the combination of the inner skin's softness and the outer skin's roughness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mare desiring the stallion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare equine expression referring to sexual readiness or desire.

cautions: Form II can announce either favorable or distressing news; the latter is an explicitly attested ironic or denunciatory use, not a Quran Foundation gloss-derived sense.

A reported Quran reading associated with Form IV has been preserved as a separate sense without converting Lane's historical citation into a modern verse location; it is not included in the supplied QAC occurrence count.
